description: Post limits of one network before creating a post: maxCaptionBytes (UTF-8 bytes), minMedia, maxMedia, allowsText, postTypes and feature flags. Link rules: linkInCaption / linkInComment are 'clickable' (URL is tappable), 'plain' (shown as text, not tappable) or 'unsupported' (the place does not exist, e.g. LinkedIn/Telegram/TikTok/Pinterest/YouTube/GBP reject firstComment with HTTP 400); linkInBioOnly=true (Instagram, TikTok) means no URL is clickable anywhere, so write 'link in bio' instead of a URL. Put links only where clickable. PINTEREST items also carry accessTier: 'trial' means pins are visible only to their creator until Pinterest approves Standard access (scheduling still works, tell the user); 'standard' means public; absent = unknown. PINTEREST items also carry maxPinTitleChars (100) and maxPinAltTextChars (500) for create_post pinTitle/pinAltText. THREADS items carry topicTag (true: create_post/update_post accept a topicTag) and maxTopicTagChars (50). YOUTUBE items carry maxYtTitleChars (100), maxYtTagsChars (500) and maxShortSeconds (postType reel = Short), and when core-api reports it dailyQuotaRemaining (uploads left today, 0 = the publish is deferred) with quotaResetsAt (ISO time of the next reset, 00:00 America/Los_Angeles); YouTube has no first comment (UNSUPPORTED_ON_CHANNEL) and needs a video. BLUESKY items carry maxCaptionGraphemes (300, counted in graphemes = what the user sees, on top of maxCaptionBytes), maxBskyAltTextChars (2000), maxMedia 4 (images, or one video), allowsText true; Bluesky supports firstComment (a reply, links clickable) and has no impressions/reach analytics. WORDPRESS items describe a blog article (postTypes [ARTICLE]): wpRequiredFields (wpTitle, wpContentHtml; create_post takes title and contentHtml/contentMarkdown), maxWpTitleChars, maxWpExcerptChars, maxWpContentBytes, maxWpTermIds, wpAllowedImageMimes for featuredImage, and a note: article metrics only via a linked Google Analytics, no account analytics and no first comment. GBP (Google Business Profile) items carry maxCaptionChars (1500, counted in Unicode code points on top of maxCaptionBytes), maxMedia 1 (one image, no video, text-only allowed), gbpPostKinds (UPDATE, EVENT, OFFER) and gbpCtaTypes; EVENT and OFFER need gbpEventTitle/gbpEventStart/gbpEventEnd, and GBP has no first comment (UNSUPPORTED_ON_CHANNEL), no best times and only location-level analytics. Read live from core-api. Requires scope ACCOUNTS_READ.
